assumptions.choice: Compute size as int(cash / (price * (1 + 0.001))) to buy as close to 100% of available capital as possible without triggering a margin rejection from the 0.001 commission.
assumptions.reason: Spec explicitly requires '100% of capital' rather than leaving sizing unstated, so the plain buy()/sell() canonical default does not apply; a commission buffer is needed since backtrader validates cash against order value plus commission before submission.

assumptions.choice: Used bt.indicators.CrossOver(self.data.close, self.sma), where a return value > 0 signals close crossing above SMA200 and < 0 signals crossing below.
assumptions.reason: Matches backtrader's standard CrossOver semantics and the spec's explicit request to use the CrossOver indicator on close vs SMA(200).

assumptions.choice: Only evaluate entry (crossover>0) when flat and exit (crossover<0) when in a position, guarded by an order-tracking attribute.
assumptions.reason: Canonical default: hold at most one position at a time with pending-order guarding via notify_order.
